lines.text: Another fresh print. Welcome to the Scrapyard, pilot. Ada. I run what's left of the gantry.
This yard broke ships for the orbital fleet. When the fleet stopped coming home, the machines kept working. The loaders, the sentries. Nobody told them to stop.
We used to have mechs. Walkers you could climb inside, big enough to take on that monstrosity in the Deadfields. The foundry that built them is under our feet.
The last blueprint is down there, in the warden's vault. Bring it to me and this gantry builds again. It'll take everyone, mind. Pilots weren't built to work alone.
The fleet did, a long time ago. The relay mast's last order was "Hold". Everything here has been holding ever since.
The hatch is in the sentry ruins, east of camp, past the long wall. Mind the sentries; they're still holding.
The vault's at the bottom, up past the foundry floor. The warden won't let it open while it's standing. Bring a squad.
I found the blueprint.
Let me see... a two-seater! Pilot and gunner. Oh, this is good.
There. The console will tell you every part it needs. Engineers, salvagers, siphoners, splicers: you'll all be on the hook for something.
The console by the pad lists every component and who's installed what. Work with your squad. Let's get this thing built!
It's finished! I never thought I'd see one stand up again.
Go on, then. Let's wake it up.
Take that walker out to the Deadfields; that's what it was built for. Bring it back in one piece if you can. If it takes a beating, some alloy plates should patch it up.
Busy, pilot. Gantry won't fix itself.
Oh! A new face. Can I measure it? No? Fine.
I'm Juno. I make art out of the yard. Right now I'm making a masterpiece, and I need three very particular things.
A sentry's eye, intact. A loader's horn. And a ventbloom grown in coolant, which is a thing I just invented. Will you help?
Yes! That's art.
Eye, horn, cold bloom. The bio-still can grow a bloom in coolant if you know a bit of Splicing.
I've got your eye, your horn and your bloom.
Ohhh. Oh, it's all coming together.
Now it needs paint. Real paint, from the old paint press in the Undercroft. It's a bit lively. Bring me its reservoir.
The press hall is off the antechamber in the Undercroft. It marks the floor before it splats it. Don't stand on the marks!
One paint reservoir, still sloshing.
Perfect. And as promised, a little something for you. I made it from the leftovers.
A paintball cannon! Harmless, mostly. Go and make the yard prettier. Oh, and I think I hear that paint press still stomping around down there, louder than ever. Might want to check it out.
My masterpiece! Isn't it awful? I love it.
The press is still down there, stomping around. Bring friends.
Art is just scrap that's been thought about.
Hello there. Pell, surveyor. Retired, technically, but nobody's mapped the Quiet Reach in forty years.
It's up that elevator. No sentries, no loaders, nothing that bites. Just a lot of very old things and a view.
Scan the landmarks, collect a few specimens, and take my drone. It talks, I'm afraid.
Here's the drone. Use it from your pack to call it out. Off you go!
Five landmarks, three specimens. If a path is blocked, look around: there's usually a way.
The survey's done.
Wonderful! Let me see the log...
Splendid work. The seeds you find up there grow nicely in the hab's grow beds, by the way.
The Reach is still there whenever you need a quiet minute. The seeds up there grow in the hab's beds.
Lovely day for it.
